resources.string: Loading-screen tips, quotes and useless facts, every hour. Tap to reroll.
Your life, but with loading-screen tips. Random quotes, useless facts, trivia and terrible advice.
“What, you egg! Young fry of treachery!”

To add the widget: long-press an empty spot on your home screen, tap Widgets, find Quote Vomit, and drag it onto your screen.\n\nEvery hour it rolls something new: a quote from anywhere in history, a useless fact, random Wikipedia trivia, or a fake game tip. Tap the widget to reroll. Offline, it uses its built-in tips and quotes.
